meta.title: {{NAME}}
meta.note: Template example (all 3D printed): a case for a 350ml can. A tube with a bottom, with lugs on the left and right for a strap. Rewrite each item to fit your own shape. scaffold fills in fab (the fabrication values) for the chosen process

can_d.label: Body diameter of the can inside (350ml, provisional; measure it)

can_neck_h.label: Height of the can shoulder, the tapered part (provisional)

can_gap.label: Gap between the can and the inner wall (per side; removable-fit clearance + can variation)

drain_d.label: Diameter of the drain hole in the bottom

lug_out.label: How far the lug sticks out from the tube

lug_top_gap.label: Top edge of the lug to the top edge of the tube

strap_clr.label: Strap slot margin (per side; for fabric, easy threading comes first)
